Theme

Kitchen, meals & drinks · Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

thin adjective

also skinny, slim, slender

classical

tenuis

Describes consistency.

Other words

  • macilentus, macilenta, macilentum — skinny, lean

    declension · also used · classical · Plaut. Capt. 3.4.114: macilentō ōre (Lewis & Short); Traupman 65

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut.; ante- and post-classical)

  • gracilis, gracile — slim, slender

    declension · also used · classical · Traupman 65: gracilis, opposite obēsus

Examples

  • Haec pōtiō tenuis est; illa dulcis est.

    This smoothie is thin; that one is sweet.composed

See also thick, smoothie.
